I forget appointments or to call people back unless she writes it in big letters on the calendar. I do feel somewhat on edge at times, especially when I realize I’ve messed something up, but the actual drifting off happens more when something new or interesting pops up, not because I’m sitting there worrying about things.

My wife keeps telling me I’m misplacing things more — my glasses, the remote, even important letters. I’ll forget to return calls, miss a dentist appointment, or only realize at night that I never put the trash out, because all day I’ve been tense and preoccupied, chest tight, stomach in knots.
